state.background: B3e-a implements six assertion-level Browser Mode cases for three stable mobile-readability rows: nominal and real SpendingBarChart fixtures at 320x667, 375x667, and 390x667. The actual chart is mounted with production key sets and deterministic 84-quarter fixture data. Independent review confirmed 21 nominal / 11 real production keys, 84 quarters, and a .container-equivalent 1rem horizontal padding and border-box baseline. Focused Browser Mode verification passed 6/6 in tests/browser-mode/SpendingBarChart-readability.browser.test.tsx. The corresponding Playwright width-loop assertion groups were removed only for 320/375/390; the 430px iteration remains intact. No production route or page-shell behavior is claimed by these component fixtures.
acceptanceCriteria: The focused Browser Mode file tests/browser-mode/SpendingBarChart-readability.browser.test.tsx passes 6/6: one nominal and one real chart case at each of 320x667, 375x667, and 390x667.
Each case sets and verifies its exact viewport and mounts actual SpendingBarChart using deterministic 84-quarter data with the production 21 nominal or 11 real expense-key set.

Independent review confirms the fixture uses the .container-equivalent 1rem horizontal padding and box-sizing border-box baseline; the component assertions cover the mapped chart-local section spacing, wrapper/SVG bounds, axes, bars, and tick geometry.
At 320, 375, and 390 only, Playwright removes P42-203–207, P42-209–213, and P42-215–217 geometry assertions.

At those widths Playwright retains P42-202 section visibility, P42-208 nonnegative Y values, P42-214 quarter-label formatting, and P42-218 document scroll width; all geometry assertions at 430px remain.
The 375/430 earnings tooltip cases and all unrelated source assertions remain unchanged. These three stable rows are partial; A=123/E=90/M=1 is unchanged.

Earlier focused authoring attempts involving a CSS Module selector, incomplete series data, and parent width were corrected; the current focused result is 6/6. No E2E is run because the cadence advances only from 2/20 to 8/20, below the 20-case gate.
No route, production page-shell, or broader mobile integration guarantee is claimed from the isolated fixtures.
verification: Focused Browser Mode evidence supplied: tests/browser-mode/SpendingBarChart-readability.browser.test.tsx, 6/6 passed.
Independent review confirmed production key counts (21 nominal / 11 real), 84-quarter fixture span, and .container-equivalent 1rem horizontal padding and border-box sizing.

Diff evidence: the E2E width loop gates/removes only P42-203–207, -209–213, and -215–217 for 320/375/390. It retains P42-202/-208/-214/-218 there, all mapped geometry checks for 430px, and both earnings tooltip cases.
Resolved earlier focused attempts: CSS Module selector, incomplete series data, and parent width were corrected before the current 6/6 result.
No E2E was run. The cadence is 8/20 including B3d's two cases; no full suite or production route guarantee is claimed.
knownConstraints: The Browser Mode fixtures exercise actual chart rendering with deterministic static data and an explicit production-equivalent container baseline; they do not exercise the live route, page shell, or data loading.
The 430px geometry iteration and retained P42-202/-208/-214/-218 assertions remain Playwright-owned, as do earnings tooltip cases.
All three stable rows remain partial and M does not increase. The next consolidated E2E remains deferred until a later valid case reaches the 20-case cadence.
state.outputRequirement: Assess whether the B3e-a implementation and focused evidence satisfy the approved partial-transfer scope. Select exactly one listed criterion and return the confidence and probability distribution. If not valid_as_defined, identify the exact affected assertion/source location, observed evidence or exact neededEvidence, concrete nextAction/proposedFix, and remainingUncertainty. Do not claim stable rows are fully migrated or that route integration moved.

implementation.instructions: Select exactly one mutually exclusive criterion for the B3e-a implementation checkpoint.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The implementation and focused evidence satisfy the approved B3e-a scope and retained E2E boundaries.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The implementation contradicts an applicable assertion ownership or acceptance requirement.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Prerequisite information is missing and prevents assessment.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The implementation or evidence is too incomplete to assess the defined checkpoint.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation defect or unsupported behavior remains.
criteria.scope_violation: The implementation exceeds the six partial assertion slices or weakens retained E2E boundaries.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the other criteria.
criteria.indeterminate: The evidence does not support a reliable determination.
